test_title: PYST 4: SSC Stenographer - Reasoning (Held on: 12 Nov 2021 Shift 2 )
subject: reasoning
question:
Study the given pattern carefully and select the number that can replace the question mark (?) in it.

(17, 9, 4) (13, ?, 7) (14, 3, 13)
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

**Sum of given numbers in brackets = 30**

 
• (17, 9, 4) → 17 + 9 + 4 = 30

And

 
• (14, 3, 13) → 14 + 3 + 13 = 30
